summary: This bill establishes a Task Force on Women in Law Enforcement to develop national hiring standards for law enforcement officers that do not disadvantage women, create recommendations for retaining and promoting female officers, and incentivize states to adopt these standards by providing additional grant funding.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a task force to develop national hiring standards for law enforcement officers and recommendations for female officer retention and promotion. It also incentivizes states to adopt these standards through additional grant funding. This directly relates to strengthening policing by improving the quality and diversity of law enforcement personnel.
